map.在原假设成立下，观察到当前或更极端结果的概率。p 小≠效应大，只说明\"不太像随: The probability of observing the current result or a more extreme one if the null hypothesis holds. A small p does not mean a large effect, only that the result looks unlikely to be random.
map.无方向假设时两侧极端都算异常，双尾 p 是单尾两倍，更保守。: Without a directional hypothesis both extremes count as unusual, so the two-tailed p is twice the one-tailed value and therefore more conservative.
map.Z 统计量 p 值（本页代码口径，erf 数值实现正态分布 Φ）：单尾 p=1−: p value for a Z statistic (as coded on this page; Φ is implemented numerically with erf): one-sided p=1−0.5×(1+erf(|z|÷√2)); two-sided p=2×one-sided; both are kept to 6 decimals. Validation: no strict validation; empty values default to 0. Criteria: no fixed grading; the larger |z|, the smaller p, and the common convention treats p<0.05 as statistically significant.
